Name: HELLO CAMPANIA! Philippines Collection
Description:
This corpus contains spoken data from 66 heritage speakers living in the Campania region in Italy.
There are data from 32 first generation (G1), 28 second generation (G2), 6 homeland (G0) speakers. The corpus contains The collection contains three folders for each group: the sociolinguistic interview (G1 and G2 did it in Italian, G0 did it in Tagalog), a language portrait, and two linguistic tasks  (the Frog story, a description of 21 video clips, all done in Tagalog).
The corpus is available for download from the repository of the EURAC Research CLARIN Centre.
